```{r trapping-report, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.align = 'center'}
# Shorebird Trapping report
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)   # needed for year()

# Load data
df <- readRDS(
  tail(sort(list.files(
    here::here("qmd", "chapter_1", "data", "spreadsheet"),
    pattern = "-spreadsheet\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE
  )), 1))


# Clean and keep relevant columns
df <- df %>%
  rename(
    Species   = speciesEN,
    Date      = DateAUS.Trap,
    radio_tag = Radio.tag.
  ) %>%
  select(Band.ID, Species, Date, radio_tag) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), !is.na(Date)) %>%
  mutate(
    Date      = as.Date(Date),
    radio_tag = toupper(trimws(radio_tag))
  )


# TABLE 1: Observations per species (rows) x date (columns)

table1 <- df %>%
  count(Species, Date) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%                      # keeps columns in chronological order
  mutate(Date = paste(year(Date), format(Date, "%b-%d"), sep = " ")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Date, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(across(-Species, ~ifelse(. == 0, NA, .)))

# One spanner per year present in the data (2021 to 2026)
years <- sort(unique(year(df$Date)))

gt_table1 <- table1 %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Species") %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Catches per Species per Date**"))

for (y in years) {
  gt_table1 <- gt_table1 %>%
    tab_spanner(label = as.character(y), columns = starts_with(as.character(y)))
}

gt_table1 <- gt_table1 %>%
  cols_label_with(fn = function(x) str_replace(x, "^\\d{4} ", "")) %>%
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_stub()) %>%
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_column_spanners()) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  data_color(
    columns = -Species,
    fn = scales::col_numeric(c("white", "#1A6FA3"), domain = c(0, 50),
                                 na.color = "#E0E0E0")) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Species)

gt_table1

# gtsave(gt_table1, here::here("catches_per_species.png"), vwidth = 1600, vheight = 800)



# TABLE 2: Summary per species

total_dates <- n_distinct(df$Date)

table2 <- df %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_trap   = n(),
    total_tagged = sum(radio_tag == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_dates_seen = n_distinct(Date),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_trap        = round(total_trap / sum(total_trap) * 100, 1),
    trapping_avg    = round(total_trap / total_dates, 2),
    trapping_rate_d = round(n_dates_seen / total_dates, 2)) %>%
  select(Species, pct_trap, total_trap, n_dates_seen, trapping_avg,
         trapping_rate_d, total_tagged) %>%
  arrange(desc(trapping_rate_d))

gt_table2 <- table2 %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Species") %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Shorebird Trapping Summary",
    subtitle = paste("Based on", total_dates, "unique trapping dates and",
                     nrow(df), "birds caught between",
                     format(min(df$Date), "%b %Y"), "and",
                     format(max(df$Date), "%b %Y"))) %>%
  cols_label(
    pct_trap        = "Proportion (%)",
    total_trap      = "Individual trapped",
    n_dates_seen    = "Day trapped",
    total_tagged    = "Total Tagged",
    trapping_avg    = "Average trapped",
    trapping_rate_d = "Chance to catch") %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Species) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = trapping_avg, decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(pct_trap, trapping_rate_d), decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Chance (1 = 100%) to catch at least one individual of the species per trapping event (calculated over the complete timeline).",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = trapping_rate_d)) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Average number of individuals trapped per event within the relative species group.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = trapping_avg)) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Proportion (%) of individuals trapped within the relative species group versus the total number of birds trapped in all species groups",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = pct_trap)) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Number of days at least one individual of the relative species group has been trapped.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = n_dates_seen)) %>%
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_stub()) %>%
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "grey50"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = total_tagged)) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  data_color(
    columns = trapping_rate_d,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(c("white", "#1A6FA3"), domain = c(0, 1),
                                 na.color = "#E0E0E0"))

gt_table2

# gtsave(gt_table2, here::here("trapping_summary.png"), vwidth = 1000, vheight = 800)



# PLOT 1: Bar graph, tagged catches by month (ignoring year)

mig_period <- data.frame(xmin = 3.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)
no_trap_1  <- data.frame(xmin = 2.5, xmax = 3.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)
no_trap_2  <- data.frame(xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)

all_months <- data.frame(
  Month     = sprintf("%02d", 1:12),
  MonthNum  = 1:12,
  MonthName = factor(month.abb, levels = month.abb)
)

# Month order (Jul -> Jun)
month_order <- c("Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec",
                 "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun")

plot1_data <- df %>%
  filter(radio_tag == "Y") %>%
  mutate(Month = format(Date, "%m")) %>%
  count(Species, Month) %>%
  complete(Species, Month = sprintf("%02d", 1:12), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  left_join(all_months, by = "Month") %>%
  mutate(MonthName = factor(MonthName, levels = month_order))

p1 <- ggplot(plot1_data, aes(x = MonthName, y = n, fill = Species)) +
  geom_rect(data = mig_period, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_rect(data = no_trap_1, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "red", alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_rect(data = no_trap_2, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "red", alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Number of catches with tagging during a typical year (summer centered)",
       x = "Month", y = "Number of catches") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
p1

# ggsave(here::here("plot1_obs_by_month.png"), plot = p1, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 600)



# PLOT 2: Trapping ratio per species by month

month_levels <- month.abb[c(6:12, 1:5)]   # Jun -> May

monthly_data <- df %>%
  mutate(Month_num = month(Date)) %>%
  count(Species, Month_num) %>%
  complete(Species, Month_num = c(6:12, 1:5), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    Month           = factor(month.abb[Month_num], levels = month_levels),
    trapping_rate_d = n / total_dates) %>%
  select(-Month_num) %>%
  filter(Species %in% table2$Species)

p3 <- ggplot(monthly_data, aes(x = Month, y = trapping_rate_d)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = trapping_rate_d), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 2)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue", guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Trapping ratio per species (summer centered)", y = "Trapping Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p3

# ggsave(here::here("trapping_rate_by_month.png"), plot = p3, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 600)
```
